svg.title: Rate transfer in one picture
svg.desc: Schematic. On the training corpus the default cut-off of 0.5 flags about 40% of items, close to the base rate. On a new corpus the scores drift, so the same cut-off flags only 12%. Rate transfer moves the cut-off until the new corpus is flagged at the training base rate again.
svg.text: SCHEMATIC · WHY THE THRESHOLD BREAKS, AND THE LABEL-FREE FIX
Rate transfer: t = quantile(new_scores, 1 − source_base_rate). The ranking is kept; only the cut-off moves.
